incidents.name: MyAi token business-logic flaw
incidents.notes: The MyAi contract's reward/transfer accounting can be driven to credit the caller without a matching deposit, so the attacker extracted the paired WBNB from the pool.

sources.ref: onchain review: MyAi 0xdb103fd28ca4b18115f5ce908baaeed7e0f1f101 created 2023-06-07T07:57:56Z by 0xedf831bbc8efe421c2604626e0cf89fd28b2f60d, unrelated to attack sender 0xc47fcc9263b026033a94574ec432514c639a2d12; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 10.7734 WBNB left 0x390d9078cb06f3cd4a17a39693b489446724a093 to the attack contract; 10.7734 WBNB x $241.08 at incidentTimestamp 1688130282 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $2,597.
